assertions.name: high-precision and float |q+q⁻¹|_mol agree to ≤ 1e-9 eV
trefoil Alexander polynomial closed form q² − 1 + q⁻²

description: Independent cross-check of |q+q⁻¹|_mol at mpmath precision (dps=60) using the high-precision figure-eight volume Vol(4_1) and the trefoil Alexander polynomial as the electronic-scale topological invariant.
caveats: The trefoil 3_1 is a torus knot T(2,3) and is non-hyperbolic, so SnapPy reports Vol(3_1) = 0.  The 'trefoil at electronic scale' cross-check is therefore implemented via the trefoil's Alexander polynomial (a topological invariant carrying comparable information), not its hyperbolic volume.

Both routes share the same nuclear quantum |q+q⁻¹|_nuc = 8 MeV and CODATA values for α, m_e/m_p, so the cross-check verifies *precision*, not *independence* in the strong sense.  A truly independent route awaits a derivation of |q+q⁻¹|_nuc from first principles (Skein-binding Lagrangian).
